# Decision record — <short title>

Copy this file into the pull request that snapshots a decision, or paste it into a decision-record issue. Outcomes live in the [Program Change Log](../06-changelog.md) as well as on the issue.

| Field | Value |
| :-- | :-- |
| Date (UTC) | |
| Chain id | 314 or 314159 |
| Decision | admission / removal / reassignment / correction / objection / other |
| Issue | |
| `taskId` | |
| Transaction | |
| Written reason | |
| Locked | yes / no — lock the issue after the decision is recorded |
